BUILT FOR GENERAL CONTRACTORS

Estimating teams

Preconstruction leaders

Bid reviewers

01 / FROM PROPOSALS TO DECISIONS

Bring the full bid
into view.

Price is one part of the decision. Review scope, supporting documents, and outstanding questions together.

01 / ORGANIZE

Bring bids together.

Manage bid packages and subcontractor responses so your team can review them in one place.

02 / COMPARE

Find the differences.

Compare responses side by side across price, scope, and value. Review items that need clarification.

03 / REVIEW

Resolve what matters.

Inspect findings and documents, shortlist bidders, and assess what remains before an award.

02 / BID INTELLIGENCE

More context.
A clearer conversation.

Built around the questions a GC needs to answer before choosing a subcontractor.

BID LEVELING 01

Are we comparing
the same scope?

Review bids in a leveling matrix, examine coverage, and identify missing or partial scope. Export the comparison for your team’s review.

AWARD READINESS 02

What still needs
our attention?

Review compliance separately from bid scoring. See documentation gaps and follow-up items, open supporting evidence, and keep your team in control of the award decision.

03 / PILOT PARTNERS

Now seeking GC companies

Help shape the way
your team reviews bids.

We’re piloting Ahylith Bid Intelligence with general contractors who compare subcontractor proposals and want a clearer view of scope, documentation, and award readiness.

We’d like to understand your current process, walk through the product with your team, and discuss a suitable bid review workflow for the pilot.

04 / ABOUT US

Built by a family
that builds.
